Public Utility Commission of Texas
1701 N. Congress Avenue

Re:     PUC Docket No. 59475; SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349 – Joint Application of Oncor
        Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA Transmission Service Corporation to Amend
        Their Certificates of Convenience and Necessity for the Bell County East Switch to Big Hill
        Substation 765-kV Transmission Line Project in Bell, Burnet, Concho, Coryell, Lampasas,
        Llano, Mason, McCulloch, Menard, Milam, Mills, San Saba, Schleicher, Tom Green, and
        Williamson Counties

Dear Mr. Olson,

On August 20, 2026, the SOAH Administrative Law Judges filed a Proposal for Decision to be
considered by the Commissioners. On that same date, Commission Counsel filed a memorandum
in Docket No. 59475 setting the deadline for parties to file exceptions to the Proposal for Decision
on September 2, 2026. The memorandum also set a deadline for filing replies to exceptions on
September 9, 2026.

In lieu of filing exceptions to the Proposal for Decision, the Theon Ranches, LP, Daniel and
Kathryn Voss, (Theon-Voss) and D & M Davis Land And Cattle, L.P. (D & M Davis) files this
letter to express its support for the Proposal for Decision’s recommendation to deny the
application. In the alternative, if the Commission determines otherwise, Theon-Voss and D&M
Davis supports the selection of Route 894 for the 765-kV transmission line for the portion of
Import Path 2.

Respectfully submitted,

/s Alfred R. Herrera
Alfred R. Herrera
State Bar No. 09529600
Herrera Law and Associates, PLLC
4400 Medical Parkway
Austin, Texas 78756

Attorney for the Theon-Voss and D&M Davis
cc: All Parties of Record
